'''Boma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. He was a member of one of the [[Senate Council (disambiguation)|Senate Council]]s.
